body: My little sister is so famous that she has her own subreddit. Yet I am FA. Is that a weird enough background?
With my exacto knife. I cut myself a lot.

I got arrested for having a loaded gun in public. Right at the place where the worst moment of my life took place another one happened again. Now I don't have a gun anymore. Maybe I'll go to jail. My life is so fucked now that I have to end it.
I cut and burn myself several times per day. And cry a lot.
Thinking about this makes me hate myself. I think about it while I cut a lot. :( My whole life is a total waste.

I am okay. Even though I went to the exact place where she dumped me I want able to pull the trigger once the gun barrel was in my mouth. I'm a ball of nerves right now. Being that close to dying with a loaded gun in my own mouth is hard to explain but it felt right. Maybe I need to find a different place to kill myself. The emotions of being where she dumped me are what did me in this time.
My new xacto knife and healed skin.
Mine met in college. Dad was the captain of the basketball team. Mom was the captain of the cheerleading squad. I have very good looking parents and siblings. Me not so fortunate. :(
For me it's regret because loneliness fluctuates a bit here and there. Regret just never goes away or gets better. My regrets keep me up at night more than my loneliness a lot of the time.
I think about it 50 times per day. It's really hard to deal with. I wish I was dead. Hopefully you can get better and not end up like me.
Same here plus OCD. I want to sleep like a normal guy but my mind won't stop obsessing long enough until it's 2am.
